facts.note: The term metaverse originated in the 1992 science fiction novel Snow Crash as a portmanteau of "meta" and "universe". In Snow Crash, the metaverse is envisioned as a version of the Internet that is a single, universal, and immersive virtual world
The Metaverse is populated by user-controlled avatars, as well as system daemons.

Stephenson has said that the title of the novel is his term for a software failure mode on the early Macintosh computer … something that looked vaguely like static on a broken television set—a 'snow crash'.
